experiments.research_question: Which OCR route preserves exact German and Russian text, punctuation, reading order, and durable page anchors at the lowest combined machine and human-correction cost?
preconditions: visual OCR projection frozen before variant output inspection

variants.version_posture: Fedora 44 tesseract 5.5.2-1.fc44 and tesseract-langpack-deu/rus 4.1.0-12.fc44 are frozen; RPM, traineddata, runner, and render digests are required at execution. PyPI OCRmyPDF 17.8.1 remains frozen but cannot block or alter the primary recognition run

variants.label: C
variants.method: PaddleOCR 3.7.0 general OCR consumes the shared frozen pages through the CPU paddle_static engine with MKLDNN disabled, batch size 1, four threads, explicit text_det_limit_side_len=960 and text_det_limit_type=max, shared PP-OCRv5_server_det, and language-specific latin_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec for German or eslav_PP-OCRv5_mobile_rec for Russian; orientation classification and document unwarping remain disabled
